error[ZBX-E0229]: devices are not available on this platform
  cause  --gpu is not available on macOS: zbx runs the container in a Linux
         virtual machine, and Apple's virtualization gives a Linux guest no GPU
         compute
  fix    run the container on a Linux machine (with a GPU, for --gpu), or leave the option out
  more   zbx explain E0229 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0229.html
